move: fourteen thin sine lines slide left and right with a faint swell
how: Fourteen SVG stroke paths, each a cubic-approximated sine wave (wavelength 320-590px, amplitude 8-16px) stacked every 30px from y=250, in teal at 25-45% opacity on a pale aqua gradient. Each line translates x by 1-3 whole wavelengths over D with ease none, alternating direction per line, so the stack shears calmly; each also lifts y by 10px plus its amplitude and returns with one sine.inOut yoyo cycle. D is 10s.
adapt: Change the stroke colour and background, the line count, spacing and amplitudes; thicker strokes and fewer lines make it bolder. Keep the whole-wavelength travel per D so each line loops seamlessly.
port: mount(el, shot) injects the SVG and generates the wave paths; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline of x sweeps and y yoyos with paths selected within el. Path widths assume a 1280 viewBox; the SVG scales to the shot.
